Review Button Not Working During Quiz in the Training Module on
the Mobile App

When attempting to take a quiz in the Training module using the 
mobile app, the Review button is available but does not work 
when clicked.

The Staff member has access to an assigned training course 
containing a quiz in the mobile app.

1. Log in to the mobile app as a Staff member. 
2. Navigate to the Training module. 
3. Open an assigned training course containing a quiz. 
4. Start the quiz and answer the questions. 
5. Click the Review button.

The Review button should work as intended and allow the Staff 
member to review their quiz answers before proceeding.
The Review button does not work when clicked in the mobile app.

Task Checklist Buttons Conflict with Each Other During 
Submission in the Mobile App

In the mobile app, when checking task checklist items and 
submitting the task, three buttons conflict with each other, causing
 unexpected behavior during the submission process.

The user is logged in to the mobile app and has an assigned 
task with checklist items.

1. Log in to the mobile app. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open an assigned task. 
4. Click the checklist items to mark them as completed. 
5. Proceed to submit the task. 
6. Observe the behavior of the three buttons during submission.

The three buttons should function independently without conflicting
 with one another, and the task should be submitted successfully.

The three buttons conflict with each other during task submission 
after the checklist items are checked.

Missing Error Message When Submitting a Task Without Clocking
In to a Shift in the Mobile App

When a staff member attempts to submit a task without clocking 
in to their assigned shift, the mobile app should display an error 
message indicating that clock-in is required. However, the 
expected error message is not displayed.

The user is logged in to the mobile app, has an assigned shift, 
and has not clocked in to that shift.

1. Log in to the mobile app as a staff member. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open an assigned task. 
4. Complete the required task information. 
5. Attempt to submit the task without clocking in to the assigned 
shift. 
6. Observe the system response.

The app should display a clear error message indicating that the 
user must clock in to the assigned shift before submitting the task.

The expected error message indicating that the user has not 
clocked in to the shift is not displayed when attempting to submit 
the task.

All Attachment Action Buttons Blink Simultaneously Instead of 
Showing Feedback on the download image section.

In the mobile app, when a task contains an attachment, clicking 
an attachment action button causes all the buttons to blink 
simultaneously. This creates a confusing user experience. 
Loading or downloading feedback should appear only on the 
button that the user clicks.
Task Attachments – Button Interaction and Loading Feedback

The user is logged in to the mobile app and has access to a task 
containing an attachment.

1. Log in to the mobile app. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open a task containing an attachment. 
4. Click any available attachment action button, such as View or 
Download. 5. Observe the visual behavior of the 
attachment action buttons.

Only the clicked button should display the appropriate visual 
feedback, such as a loading indicator or downloading message, 
while the action is in progress. Other buttons should remain 
unaffected.

All attachment action buttons blink simultaneously when one of 
them is clicked, instead of providing feedback only on the selected
button.

Resident Names Are Not Displayed in the Resident Section 
During Task Creation

When creating a task in the mobile app, the Resident section does
not display the resident's name, preventing the user from properly 
identifying or selecting the relevant resident.

The user is logged in to the mobile app and has access to the task
 creation feature. Residents are available in the system.

1. Log in to the mobile app. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open the task creation form. 
4. Locate the Resident section. 
5. Check whether the resident's name is displayed.

The Resident section should display the available resident names
 so the user can identify and select the appropriate resident.

The resident's name is not displayed in the Resident section during
task creation.

Task with Required Staff Signature Is Marked as Completed 
Instead of Awaiting Review

When a task is created with the Sign In Required option enabled, 
the staff member completes the task, provides the required 
signature, and submits it. However, the task is displayed as 
Completed instead of Awaiting Review on the Manager's end.
Task Completion – Signature Requirement and Review Workflow

The user has permission to create tasks, and the Sign In Required
 option is enabled when creating a task.

1. Log in to the application as a Manager. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Create a task with the Sign In Required option enabled and 
assign it to a staff member. 
4. Log in to the mobile app as the assigned staff member. 
5. Open the assigned task and complete the required information. 
6. Provide the required signature. 7. Submit the task as completed.
8. Log in as the Manager and check the task status.

The Resident section should display the available resident names
 so the user can identify and select the appropriate resident.

The task status is displayed as Completed on the Manager's end
 instead of Awaiting Review.
Clicking the Check Back Button Also Affects the Approve Button

In the task review section, when the Manager clicks the Check 
Back button, the same action is also reflected in the Approve 
button. These two actions should work independently without 
affecting each other.
Task Review – Check Back and Approve Actions
The Manager is logged in and has a submitted task awaiting review.

1. Log in to the application as a Manager. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open a task awaiting review. 
4. Click the Check Back button. 
5. Observe the behavior of the Approve button.

Clicking the Check Back button should trigger only the check-back 
action. The Approve button should remain unaffected.
Clicking the Check Back button also affects the Approve button.

Housekeeping Staff Do Not Receive Task Assignment Notifications
in the Mobile App

When a task is created and assigned to Housekeeping staff, the 
assigned staff member does not receive a notification in the mobile
 app.

The user is logged in to the web application with permission to 
create tasks, and a Housekeeping staff member is available for 
task assignment.

1. Log in to the web application. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Create a new task for the Housekeeping department. 
4. Assign the task to a Housekeeping staff member. 
5. Save the task. 6. Check the assigned staff member's mobile 
app for a notification.

The assigned Housekeeping staff member should receive a 
notification in the mobile app when a task is created and assigned
 to them.

The assigned Housekeeping staff member does not receive any 
notification in the mobile app after the task is created.

All Three Document Action Buttons Are Triggered Simultaneously
on the Housekeeping Side

On the Housekeeping side of the mobile app, when a user clicks 
an action button for an uploaded document, all three buttons 
respond or reflect the action simultaneously instead of responding
independently.

The user is logged in to the mobile app as Housekeeping staff and
has access to a task containing an uploaded document.

1. Log in to the mobile app as Housekeeping staff. 
2. Navigate to the Task module. 
3. Open a task containing an uploaded document. 
4. Click any one of the three document action buttons. 
5. Observe the behavior of all three buttons.

Only the clicked button should respond and display the relevant 
action feedback. The other two buttons should remain unaffected.

All three document action buttons respond or reflect the action 
simultaneously when only one button is clicked.
